responsibility: This file implements emission of GCC’s internal HSA representation into binary BRIG and registration of the resulting image with libgomp. It manages the BRIG data/code/operand sections, writes section contents and headers in the required little-endian binary layout, tracks offsets for functions and operands that need later fixups, emits function and internal-function declarations, and finally outputs the .brig ELF section plus static constructor/destructor calls to GOMP offload registration hooks. Its responsibility is the final serialization and object-file integration stage of HSA code generation, not GIMPLE lowering or register allocation.
